name: Eri Nichibotsu
source:
Eri Nichibotsu, sister of Kotomi Nichibotsu, is employed as a police detective. She is 20 years old at the beginning of vivid/stasis. Originally being passive aggressive with Saturday, she later joins the main cast in their search for Tsuki.

[spoiler]It is later revealed that Eri, along with Kotomi, was transported to the simulated world from another world in the world axis.[/spoiler]
